title: HookEvent
description: Normalized cross-harness hook event envelope for host-neutral hook handlers and probe telemetry.

schema_version.description: Schema version for the normalized hook event envelope.

platform.description: Harness or platform that produced the original event.

host_event.description: Original harness event name, for example SessionStart or PostToolUse.

session_id.description: Session identifier from the hook payload or environment.

cwd.description: Working directory when the hook fired. Probe telemetry may redact this to null and expose presence/equality metadata under probe.

source.description: Session-start or compaction source when supplied by the host.

model.description: Model identifier when supplied by the host.

permission_mode.description: Host permission mode when supplied by the payload.

turn_id.description: Turn identifier for turn-scoped hooks when supplied by the host.

tool.description: Tool name for tool-scoped hook events.

tool_input.description: Normalized tool input payload when available. Probe telemetry may redact this to null and expose shape metadata under probe.

tool_output.description: Normalized tool output payload when available. Probe telemetry may redact this to null and expose shape metadata under probe.

session.description: Normalized session metadata, including transcript paths when present. Probe telemetry may redact path values.

raw.description: Original platform payload retained for adapters that need unmapped fields. Probe telemetry should omit raw payloads.

probe.description: Probe-only metadata such as process cwd and environment-key presence. Never store secret values.
